UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account data with settings, saved YouTube links, tasks, history, notes, and paused timer state

savedLinks.description: User saved and pasted YouTube background and music links

tasks.description: User focus tasks with icons, ordering, estimates, and subtasks

todos.description: User Notion-style todo pages with status, icon, tags, subtasks, priority, and scheduled reminder timestamps

todoPrefs.description: User todo reminder notification quote preferences and preferred database view mode

timer.description: Last paused or idle timer state

pomodoro.description: Pomodoro config, cycleTally, and daily focusStats map

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms of last sync

StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: Collaborative study room where friends focus together in real time

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the current room host

timer.description: Synchronized room timer state including drift-free targetEndTime

locked.description: Whether new joins are temporarily locked by host

closed.description: Whether the room was explicitly closed by the host

maxMembers.description: Maximum allowed active participants in the room

sharedGoalTargetMs.description: Collective room focus target in milliseconds

groupHardcore.description: Whether the room encourages synchronized Group Hardcore sessions

sprintStartAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms when a scheduled 60s group sprint begins

mutedUserIds.description: Bounded list of user UIDs muted in chat by the host

kickedUserIds.description: Bounded list of user UIDs removed from the room by the host

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms of room creation

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms of last room activity

RoomMember.title: RoomMember
RoomMember.description: Member presence record inside a study room

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member

activeTaskDone.description: Whether the member's visible room task is marked completed

hardcoreMode.description: Whether the member currently has Hardcore Mode active

isHost.description: Whether this member is the room host

RoomMessage.title: RoomMessage
RoomMessage.description: Chat message, encouragement reaction, nudge, or system milestone inside a study room

text.description: Text message content, reaction emoji, or nudge

type.description: Type of message: chat, reaction, system, or nudge

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account document storing all synced cloud data

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Study room metadata and shared timer state

/rooms/{roomCode}/members/{memberId}.description: Presence of active participants in this study room

/rooms/{roomCode}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time room chat and motivation reaction messages
